At implementation start, obtain lead wave0 revision and accepted WP-10/WP-15 typed interfaces/migration/scenario receipts, rehash/re-inspect any changed seam, resolve shared pages module ownership and formula/workbook/range semantics, then contribute strict spreadsheet DTOs to the existing accepted pages contracts before service/repository migration and React integration. risks: Spreadsheet-specific formula/value/range/workbook format semantics are not fully defined by the generic value object or operation name; framework adoption cannot stand in for accepted behavior and license decisions.
The first three normative new paths overlap WP-10/WP-15; recreating or overwriting them would destroy the document/anchor foundations and introduce a second authority.
PageKind is an HTML sandbox capability; adding spreadsheet as a PageKind would mix domain/content representation with untrusted HTML execution privileges.
Current legacy Page write handlers use local filesystem functions and _ctx; adding a new gateway without WP-51 guard leaves a bypass. Existing source-action grants/render leases are not resource ACL.
createPage emits local page_<id> while domain Rox2EntityRef uses kind:id; migration must preserve aliases and canonical identity rather than silently rewrite local IDs or merge same-name Pages.
Separate CRDT append, receipt commit and projection delivery require an accepted coordinator; PostgreSQL transaction alone cannot prove atomic external CRDT durability.

A whole-workbook expectedRevision CAS would incorrectly reject legitimate different-cell concurrent edits; unconditional CRDT merge would incorrectly accept structurally stale/deleted cell targets or revoked offline operations.

Formula derivation may diverge through function/numeric ordering, reference moves, cycles or client/server schema differences; bounded deterministic evaluation and reconnect negative controls are essential.
Workbook export/import can lose formulas, errors, stable anchors, precision or schema information; fidelity requirements and supported format must be explicit and independently round-tripped.

Generic notification/search/agent completeness remains required even though integration symbols outside allowed direct-import scope were not inspected. Root must supply accepted owner ports, not treat missing prerequisites as N/A.

Current UI collapses direct-fetch failure into null and derives empty from missing HTML digest; using those branches unchanged would hide permission/error states and make blank spreadsheets appear unimplemented.

All hashes refer to working-tree bytes inspected during root-owned wave0 activity. Any subsequent shared integration invalidates affected evidence and requires re-inspection; no runtime pass or feature implementation is claimed.
